raison: Le texte explique les sigles anglais LFG et LFM (« Looking For Group / Member »), qui ne se traduisent pas sans perdre leur sens ; décision à prendre sur leur traitement. Proposition : garder LFG et LFM, traduire les expansions (« Recherche de groupe », « Recherche de membre »).
en: LFG, short for 'Looking For Group', is a common term used by players who are seeking others to join them in multiplayer content such as Dungeons, Raids, world bosses, or group quests. If you're playing solo but want to take on group-based challenges, typing 'LFG' in chat (often followed by the name or level of the activity, like 'LFG 70 Dungeons' is the standard way to signal that you're available and ready to team up.\r\n\r\nThe opposite of this is LFM, or 'Looking For Member', which is used when a player or group already has a party started and is recruiting others to fill specific roles, such as a tank, healer, or DPS. For example, someone might post 'LFM Tank and Heals for mythic+' if they already have damage dealers and need the remaining roles.
